address: 99-101 Bermondsey Street, Southwark, London, SE1 3XB, United Kingdom
bio: Something of a Bermondsey institution, this charming pub is known for its vintage look and relaxed, buzzy atmosphere. Get comfy in one of the cosy booths to enjoy contemporary British dishes made from good quality seasonal produce. Roasts are a big hit on Sundays and the daily changing menu makes a feature of the fresh fish specials, such as a fabulous John Dory to share. The friendly, organised service team have an eye for detail that further enhances the experience....
